patch_description: Replace the plain Dijkstra routing with a read-only, edge-reuse-aware candidate selection. For each destination, generate up to 4 k-shortest candidates via shortest_simple_paths, score each as raw cost minus a discount for edges already used by previously routed destinations (shared trunks get consolidated, reducing redundant transfers), plus a small congestion penalty for edges used many times to balance load across networks. Unlike Gen 4's cost-mutation approach, we never modify G or h — we only re-score candidates — avoiding fragility while exploiting shared trunks and multi-network paths. Falls back to Dijkstra on errors.
